assertions.predicate: After merge and installation of the exact full runtime SHA, the coordinator runs the authorized installed .venv/bin/python -m lib.outlook_triage --proof-window --copy with an explicit absolute authorized research directory. Read one current-attempt outlook-triage-receipt with ops/studio-triage-containment-observe.py --receipt-file FILE --runtime-sha FULL_SHA. Require matching full runtime_sha, state skipped, reason capability_not_verified or executor_unavailable, and counts.run fields snapshot_validated=true, observed > 0, moved=0, held=true, exit_code=78. Missing or mistyped fields, exit 0 even with moves while held, and every other exit fail. Independently verify snapshot and manifest provenance, mode 0600 snapshot and mode 0700 publication directory. No-copy, stale evidence, nested symlink escape or source overlap cannot satisfy this predicate. The observer never launches a job or refreshes runtime.
assertions.expected_result: The next Studio rerun of the containment proof passes on the real receipt with the auto-filing gate held. A current validated nonempty snapshot with zero moves and held exit 78 proves producer containment only, never filing or trusted receipt ingestion.
assertions.input_class: one explicit actual-run outlook-triage receipt plus current-attempt snapshot and provenance from the authorized installed research-copy proof; no mailbox send or move; observer never launches a job or refreshes runtime
